CBATTRequest.doc: A request that uses the Attribute Protocol (ATT).

CBAttribute.doc: A representation of common aspects of services offered by a peripheral.

CBCentral.doc: A remote device connected to a local app, which is acting as a peripheral.

CBCentralManager.doc: An object that scans for, discovers, connects to, and manages peripherals.

CBCharacteristic.doc: A characteristic of a remote peripheral’s service.

CBDescriptor.doc: An object that provides further information about a remote peripheral’s characteristic.

CBL2CAPChannel.doc: A live L2CAP connection to a remote device.

CBManager.doc: The abstract base class that manages central and peripheral objects.

CBMutableCharacteristic.doc: A characteristic of a local peripheral’s service.

CBMutableDescriptor.doc: An object that provides additional information about a local peripheral’s characteristic.

CBMutableService.doc: A service with writeable property values.

CBPeer.doc: An object that represents a remote device.

CBPeripheralManager.doc: An object that manages and advertises peripheral services exposed by this app.

CBService.doc: A collection of data and associated behaviors that accomplish a function or feature of a device.

CBUUID.doc: A universally unique identifier, as defined by Bluetooth standards.

CBCentralManagerDelegate.doc: A protocol that provides updates for the discovery and management of peripheral devices.

CBPeripheralDelegate.doc: A protocol that provides updates on the use of a peripheral’s services.

CBPeripheralManagerDelegate.doc: A protocol that provides updates for local peripheral state and interactions with remote central devices.

CBATTError.doc: An error that Core Bluetooth returns while using Attribute Protocol (ATT).

CBAttributePermissions.doc: Values that represent the read, write, and encryption permissions for a characteristic’s value.

CBAttributePermissionsReadEncryptionRequ.doc: A permission that indicates only trusted devices can read the attribute’s value.

CBAttributePermissionsReadable.doc: A permission that indicates a peripheral can read the attribute’s value.

CBAttributePermissionsWriteEncryptionReq.doc: A permission that indicates only trusted devices can write the attribute’s value.

CBAttributePermissionsWriteable.doc: A permission that indicates a peripheral can write the attribute’s value.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a permissions instance from the provided raw value.

CBCentralManagerFeature.doc: An option set of device-specific features.

CBCentralManagerState.doc: Values that represent the current state of a central manager object.

CBCentralManagerStatePoweredOff.doc: A state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered off.

CBCentralManagerStatePoweredOn.doc: A state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered on and available to use.

CBCentralManagerStateResetting.doc: A state that indicates the connection with the system service was momentarily lost.

CBCentralManagerStateUnauthorized.doc: A state that indicates the application isn’t authorized to use the Bluetooth low energy role.

CBCentralManagerStateUnsupported.doc: A state that indicates this device doesn’t support the Bluetooth low energy central or client role.

CBCharacteristicProperties.doc: Values that represent the possible properties of a characteristic.

CBCharacteristicPropertyAuthenticatedSig.doc: A property that indicates the perhipheral allows signed writes of the characteristic’s value, without a response to indicate the write succeeded.

CBCharacteristicPropertyBroadcast.doc: A property that indicates the characteristic can broadcast its value using a characteristic configuration descriptor.

CBCharacteristicPropertyExtendedProperti.doc: A property that indicates the characteristic defines additional properties in the extended properties descriptor.

CBCharacteristicPropertyIndicate.doc: A property that indicates the peripheral permits notifications of the characteristic’s value, with a response from the central to indicate receipt of the notification.

CBCharacteristicPropertyIndicateEncrypti.doc: A property that indicates only trusted devices can enable indications of the characteristic’s value.

CBCharacteristicPropertyNotify.doc: A property that indicates the peripheral permits notifications of the characteristic’s value, without a response from the central to indicate receipt of the notification.

CBCharacteristicPropertyNotifyEncryption.doc: A property that indicates that only trusted devices can enable notifications of the characteristic’s value.

CBCharacteristicPropertyRead.doc: A property that indicates a peripheral can read the characteristic’s value.

CBCharacteristicPropertyWrite.doc: A property that indicates a peripheral can write the characteristic’s value, with a response to indicate that the write succeeded.

CBCharacteristicPropertyWriteWithoutResp.doc: A property that indicates a peripheral can write the characteristic’s value, without a response to indicate that the write succeeded.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a characteristic properties instance from the given raw value.

CBCharacteristicWriteType.doc: Values representing the possible write types to a characteristic’s value.

CBCharacteristicWriteWithResponse.doc: Write a characteristic value, with a response from the peripheral to indicate whether the write was successful.

CBCharacteristicWriteWithoutResponse.doc: Write a characteristic value, without any response from the peripheral to indicate whether the write was successful.

CBConnectionEvent.doc: A change to the connection state of a peer.

CBConnectionEventPeerConnected.doc: The peer has connected to the local device.

CBConnectionEventPeerDisconnected.doc: The peer has disconnected from the local device.

CBError.doc: An error that Core Bluetooth returns during Bluetooth transactions.

CBManagerAuthorization.doc: The current authorization state of a Core Bluetooth manager.

CBManagerAuthorizationAllowedAlways.doc: A state that indicates the user has authorized Bluetooth at any time.

CBManagerAuthorizationDenied.doc: A state that indicates the user explicitly denied Bluetooth access for this app.

CBManagerAuthorizationNotDetermined.doc: A state that indicates the user has yet to authorize Bluetooth for this app.

CBManagerAuthorizationRestricted.doc: A state that indicates this app isn’t authorized to use Bluetooth.

CBManagerState.doc: The possible states of a Core Bluetooth manager.

CBManagerStatePoweredOff.doc: A state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered off.

CBManagerStatePoweredOn.doc: A state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered on and available to use.

CBManagerStateResetting.doc: A state that indicates the connection with the system service was momentarily lost.

CBManagerStateUnauthorized.doc: A state that indicates the application isn’t authorized to use the Bluetooth low energy role.

CBManagerStateUnsupported.doc: A state that indicates this device doesn’t support the Bluetooth low energy central or client role.

CBPeripheralManagerAuthorizationStatus.doc: Values representing the current authorization state of the peripheral manager.

CBPeripheralManagerAuthorizationStatusAu.doc: An authorization status that indicates the user authorized this app to share data using Bluetooth while in the background.

CBPeripheralManagerAuthorizationStatusDe.doc: An authorization status that indicates the user explicitly denied this app from sharing data using Bluetooth while in the background.

CBPeripheralManagerAuthorizationStatusNo.doc: An authorization status that indicates the user hasn’t indicated whether this app can share data using Bluetooth while in the background.

CBPeripheralManagerAuthorizationStatusRe.doc: An authorization status that indicates this app isn’t authorized to share data using Bluetooth while in the background.

CBPeripheralManagerConnectionLatency.doc: Values representing the connection latency of the peripheral manager.

CBPeripheralManagerConnectionLatencyHigh.doc: A latency setting that prioritizes extending battery life over rapid communication.

CBPeripheralManagerConnectionLatencyLow.doc: A latency setting indicating that prioritizes rapid communication over battery life.

CBPeripheralManagerConnectionLatencyMedi.doc: A latency setting that balances communication frequency and battery life.

CBPeripheralManagerState.doc: Values that represent the current state of the peripheral manager.

CBPeripheralManagerStatePoweredOff.doc: A manager state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered off.

CBPeripheralManagerStatePoweredOn.doc: A manager state that indicates Bluetooth is currently powered on and is available to use.

CBPeripheralManagerStateResetting.doc: A manager state that indicates the connection with the system service was momentarily lost.

CBPeripheralManagerStateUnauthorized.doc: A manager state that indicates the app isn’t authorized to use the Bluetooth low energy peripheral/server role.

CBPeripheralManagerStateUnknown.doc: A manager state that indicates the current state of the peripheral manager is unknown.

CBPeripheralManagerStateUnsupported.doc: A manager state that indicates the platform doesn’t support the Bluetooth low energy peripheral/server role.

CBPeripheralState.doc: Values representing the connection state of a peripheral.

CBPeripheralStateConnected.doc: The peripheral is connected to the central manager.

CBPeripheralStateConnecting.doc: The peripheral is in the process of connecting to the central manager.

CBPeripheralStateDisconnected.doc: The peripheral isn’t connected to the central manager.

CBPeripheralStateDisconnecting.doc: The peripheral is disconnecting from the central manager.

+supportsFeatures:.doc: Returns a Boolean that indicates whether the device supports a specific set of features.

-cancelPeripheralConnection:.doc: Cancels an active or pending local connection to a peripheral.

-connectPeripheral:options:.doc: Establishes a local connection to a peripheral.

-init.doc: Initializes the central manager without a delegate.

-initWithDelegate:queue:.doc: Initializes the central manager with a specified delegate and dispatch queue.

-initWithDelegate:queue:options:.doc: Initializes the central manager with specified delegate, dispatch queue, and initialization options.

-registerForConnectionEventsWithOptions:.doc: Register for an event notification when the central manager makes a connection matching the given options.

-retrieveConnectedPeripheralsWithService.doc: Returns a list of the peripherals connected to the system whose services match a given set of criteria.

-retrievePeripheralsWithIdentifiers:.doc: Returns a list of known peripherals by their identifiers.

-scanForPeripheralsWithServices:options:.doc: Scans for peripherals that are advertising services.

-stopScan.doc: Asks the central manager to stop scanning for peripherals.

-initWithType:properties:value:permissio.doc: Creates a mutable characteristic with specified permissions, properties, and value.

-initWithType:value:.doc: Creates a mutable descriptor with a specified value.

-initWithType:primary:.doc: Creates a newly initialized mutable service specified by UUID and service type.

-discoverCharacteristics:forService:.doc: Discovers the specified characteristics of a service.

-discoverDescriptorsForCharacteristic:.doc: Discovers the descriptors of a characteristic.

-discoverIncludedServices:forService:.doc: Discovers the specified included services of a previously-discovered service.

-discoverServices:.doc: Discovers the specified services of the peripheral.

-maximumWriteValueLengthForType:.doc: The maximum amount of data, in bytes, you can send to a characteristic in a single write type.

-openL2CAPChannel:.doc: Attempts to open an L2CAP channel to the peripheral using the supplied Protocol/Service Multiplexer (PSM).

-readRSSI.doc: Retrieves the current RSSI value for the peripheral while connected to the central manager.

-readValueForCharacteristic:.doc: Retrieves the value of a specified characteristic.

-readValueForDescriptor:.doc: Retrieves the value of a specified characteristic descriptor.

-setNotifyValue:forCharacteristic:.doc: Sets notifications or indications for the value of a specified characteristic.

-writeValue:forCharacteristic:type:.doc: Writes the value of a characteristic.

-writeValue:forDescriptor:.doc: Writes the value of a characteristic descriptor.

+authorizationStatus.doc: Returns the app’s authorization status for sharing data while in the background.

-addService:.doc: Publishes a service and any of its associated characteristics and characteristic descriptors to the local GATT database.

-init.doc: Initializes the peripheral manager without a delegate.

-initWithDelegate:queue:.doc: Initializes the peripheral manager with a specified delegate and dispatch queue.

-initWithDelegate:queue:options:.doc: Initializes the peripheral manager with a specified delegate, dispatch queue, and initialization options.

-publishL2CAPChannelWithEncryption:.doc: Creates a listener for incoming L2CAP channel connections.

-removeAllServices.doc: Removes all published services from the local GATT database.

-removeService:.doc: Removes a specified published service from the local GATT database.

-respondToRequest:withResult:.doc: Responds to a read or write request from a connected central.

-setDesiredConnectionLatency:forCentral:.doc: Sets the desired connection latency for an existing connection to a central device.

-unpublishL2CAPChannel:.doc: Removes a published service from the local system.

-updateValue:forCharacteristic:onSubscri.doc: Send an updated characteristic value to one or more subscribed centrals, using a notification or indication.

+UUIDWithCFUUID:.doc: Creates a Core Bluetooth UUID object from a Core Foundation UUID object.

+UUIDWithData:.doc: Creates a Core Bluetooth UUID object from a 16-, 32-, or 128-bit UUID data container.

+UUIDWithNSUUID:.doc: Creates a Core Bluetooth UUID object from a Foundation UUID object.

+UUIDWithString:.doc: Creates a Core Bluetooth UUID object from a 16-, 32-, or 128-bit UUID string.

central.doc: The remote central device that originated the request.

characteristic.doc: The characteristic to read or write the value of.

offset.doc: The zero-based index of the first byte for the read or write request.

value.doc: The data that the central reads from or writes to the peripheral.

UUID.doc: The Bluetooth-specific UUID of the attribute.

maximumUpdateValueLength.doc: The maximum amount of data, in bytes, that the central can receive in a single notification or indication.

CBCentralManagerFeature.doc: An option set of device-specific features.

delegate.doc: The delegate object that you want to receive central manager events.

isScanning.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the central is currently scanning.

descriptors.doc: A list of the descriptors discovered in this characteristic.

isBroadcasted.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the characteristic the service broadcasts this characteristic.

isNotifying.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the characteristic is currently notifying a subscribed central of its value.

service.doc: The service to which this characteristic belongs.

characteristic.doc: The characteristic to which this descriptor belongs.

inputStream.doc: The stream used for reading data from the remote peer.

outputStream.doc: The stream used for writing data to the peer.

peer.doc: The peer connected to the channel.

authorization.doc: The current authorization status for using Bluetooth.

state.doc: The current state of the manager.

descriptors.doc: An array of the characteristic’s descriptors.

permissions.doc: The permissions of the characteristic value.

subscribedCentrals.doc: A list of centrals that are currently subscribed to the characteristic’s value.

characteristics.doc: A list of characteristics of a service.

identifier.doc: The UUID associated with the peer.

RSSI.doc: The Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI), in decibels, of the peripheral.

ancsAuthorized.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the remote device has authorization to receive data over ANCS protocol.

canSendWriteWithoutResponse.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the remote device can send a write without a response.

delegate.doc: The delegate object specified to receive peripheral events.

services.doc: A list of a peripheral’s discovered services.

state.doc: The connection state of the peripheral.

delegate.doc: The delegate object specified to receive peripheral events.

isAdvertising.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the peripheral is advertising data.

characteristics.doc: A list of characteristics discovered in this service.

includedServices.doc: A list of included services discovered in this service.

isPrimary.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the type of service is primary or secondary.

peripheral.doc: The peripheral to which this service belongs.

UUIDString.doc: The UUID represented as a string.
